title: Engineering Executives: Successfully Run Engineering with AI | Faros

hero.headline: Accelerate engineering delivery
hero.subhead: Strategic decisions without full context make it harder to move fast and win. Faros provides visibility and control to deploy AI at scale.

sections.heading: Outcomes we deliver — run engineering like an AI company
sections.body: Deliver 10x with agents (assign tasks to agents that have org context), build a next-gen workforce, transform with AI faster, measure productivity impact for the boardroom.

sections.heading: How engineering executives use Faros
sections.body: Grow revenue by releasing faster, attract and retain top AI talent, eliminate wasted budgets and inefficiencies, demonstrate engineering's business results (tie initiatives to revenue, cost savings, CLV).

sections.heading: What you get
sections.body: The Context Engine (unified data model), Executive Scorecards (KPI + AI impact monitoring for leadership), Transformation Roadmaps (quarterly AI-maturity assessment + 90-day plan), Strategic Resource Allocation, AI-driven Insights (anomaly/risk detection), Enterprise-Grade Security.

notes: Retrieved via Claude-in-Chrome (get_page_text). Role/solution page for CTOs and VPs. Closest persona match after ai-leaders; 'measure productivity impact, take it to the boardroom' and 'demonstrate engineering's business results' corroborate persona:maya's board-ROI pressure and the money-is-the-door discipline. Names two distinct features worth nodes: Executive Scorecards and Transformation Roadmaps. Testimonial: Mustafa Furniturewala, SVP Engineering, Coursera.
